analyst.summary: Karur Vysya Bank posted a standout June-2026 quarter -- profit up 45%, still among the best asset quality in the sector (GNPA 0.74%, NNPA 0.19%) -- and trades at an inexpensive ~11x earnings for that quality. The catch is that management itself is guiding margins to compress from today's elevated level over the rest of the year, so this quarter's profit growth rate is not the sustainable run-rate. We rate it a Hold: a well-run bank at a fair price, not a bargain and not a risk either.
